source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
Once per battle, as your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase) starts, you can pick 1 enemy unit the bearer can see within 9" and roll a D6. On a 3+, deal D3 **[mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds)** to the picked unit, or 2D3 against **VEHICLE** and **FORTIFICATIONS** units.

A Remote Mine token can stay beside the unit until this ability is used.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 8 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.

ability.designersNote: place a Remote Mine token next to the unit and remove it once the ability has been used
